Navigation

Animated Sidebar

App navigation sidebar that folds into an icon rail.

@qinyang/theme@qinyang/icons@qinyang/tooltip@base-ui/reactmotion
N
NorthwindPro workspace
Workspace
Beacon⌘/Ctrl+B to toggle

Installation

$pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @qinyang/animated-sidebar

Usage

import {
  Sidebar,
  SidebarContent,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarInset,
  SidebarItem,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarProvider,
  SidebarTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/animated-sidebar"
<SidebarProvider>
  <Sidebar>
    <SidebarContent>
      <SidebarGroup>
        <SidebarMenu>
          <SidebarItem icon={<HomeIcon />} label="Home" isActive />
        </SidebarMenu>
      </SidebarGroup>
    </SidebarContent>
  </Sidebar>
  <SidebarInset>
    <SidebarTrigger />
  </SidebarInset>
</SidebarProvider>

Composition

SidebarProvider
├── Sidebar
│   ├── SidebarHeader
│   │   └── SidebarHideCollapsed
│   ├── SidebarContent
│   │   └── SidebarGroup
│   │       ├── SidebarGroupLabel
│   │       └── SidebarMenu
│   │           └── SidebarItem
│   │               └── SidebarSub
│   │                   └── SidebarSubItem
│   └── SidebarFooter
└── SidebarInset
    └── SidebarTrigger

Examples

Icon Rail

Use defaultOpen={false} on the provider when the content needs the width; rail items show their label or tooltip as a tooltip.

Flush, Right Side

Use variant="sidebar" for full-height app shells, and side="right" for secondary panels.

Controlled

Use open and onOpenChange when other UI must fold the rail or a disclosure item.

Non-collapsible Links

Use collapsible="none" for short link lists that never fold.

RTL

For right-to-left languages, wrap the tree in DirectionProvider; side="left" then puts the sidebar on the right.

Keyboard

⌘/Ctrl + B toggles the sidebar; change the key with shortcut or pass null to turn it off. All sidebars share one listener, so with several on a page, only the most recently mounted, focused or clicked one toggles. Disclosure items set aria-expanded and aria-controls.

Related

See also AI Sidebar.

API Reference

SidebarProvider

Holds the open state and lays out the sidebar and inset in a row. Also accepts every prop of div.

boolean
Controlled expanded state.
defaultOpen= true
boolean
Initial expanded state when uncontrolled.
onOpenChange
(open: boolean) => void
Called when the sidebar expands or collapses.
shortcut= "b"
string | null
Key that toggles with ⌘/Ctrl. Only the most recently mounted, focused or clicked sidebar responds. null disables the shortcut.

Sidebar

The panel. Its width springs between --sidebar-width (15rem) and --sidebar-width-icon (3.75rem). Also accepts every prop of motion.aside.

"left" | "right"
Which side of the inset it sits on.
variant= "floating"
"floating" | "sidebar"
floating is a raised rounded card; sidebar sits flush with a hairline edge.

icon folds into an icon rail; none never collapses.

string
Class for the inner panel surface.
